bias.en: Bearish · rebound up to the 200-day average
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹至 200 日均线

read.en: Arm jumped 6.2% on Oct 26 to $223.35, trading between $210.85 and $225.63. It is above the falling 5-day average ($218.3), and below the falling 10-day ($228.6), 30-day ($269.3) and 100-day ($286.3) and the rising 200-day ($226.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($241.17), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Arm 10月26日大涨 6.2%，收于 $223.35，盘中区间 $210.85–225.63。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$218.3）上方，低于下行的 10 日（$228.6）、30 日（$269.3）、100 日均线（$286.3）和上行的 200 日均线（$226.6）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$241.17），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The bounce off the $208 lows reclaimed $217.3–219.4 (Oct 20 and Aug 3 lows, 5-day), and the $225.6 high stopped just under the 200-day. Resistance is $225.6–226.6, then $228.6–229 (10-day, Oct 21 high) and $238–241 (Sep 14 low, SAR). Support is $217.3–219.4, then $208.3–208.5 and $200–200.9. A close above $226.6 would target $229, then $238; a close below $217.3 would put $208.3 back in play.
